phase: prospective exact geometry/gradient backend port; v0.1.2 full official evaluation still running and results will be retained
scientific_state: No training or coefficient/base-weight/feature-definition changes; same83-molecule training-only GroupCV state
motivation: Training-geometry profile shows CPU geometric-feature autograd and mixed-backend boundary overhead in addition to dense GPU work. Reduce general scalar ASE inference overhead without benchmark-specific tables, curves or fitting.
design: Port original lmax3 component-normalized spherical harmonics,8-term Bessel basis,6A polynomial envelope and ZBL(p6) to MLX; differentiate the whole raw-energy function with respect to general directed periodic edge vectors in a single compiled value_and_grad. Assemble atomic forces and symmetric virial stress from these vector gradients. Preserve original ZBL atomic-index convention exactly, even where surprising. Original CPU graph construction remains.
composition_cache: At most one frozen atomic-number sequence may cache its node embedding/reference energy; never cache geometry, curves, energies, forces, stress or targets. This is applicable to any MD/relaxation sequence. Initial work is charged to load/sweep as performed.
test_first: Failing unit tests compare features/geometric VJPs/ZBL to actual frozen ORB code and edge-gradient assembly to original Torch strain/position differentiation, including periodic self images and empty edges. Then compare full E/F/stress on all83 training plus100 synthetic cases.
numerical_gate: atol1e-4+rtol1e-5 on all183 cases; fail closed on unsupported configs/nonfinite values. Do not loosen after results.
timing_gate: Fixed first20 training structures,5 paired alternating repeats, synchronized GPU,CPUthreads4 fixed; native geometry must reduce median scalar E/F/stress latency at least20% vs frozen v0.1.2 hybrid. No own heavy jobs during timed official sweeps.
selection: Only label-free equivalence/timing gates; no official reference score or holdout targets. Historical score-informed redesign remains disclosed with test_set_informed:[diatomics].
official_eval: If gates pass, freeze source/artifact before a new complete shared-runner evaluation. Never overwrite v0.1.0/v0.1.1/v0.1.2 results or report a below-target model as top3.
